en_title: Bill Skarsgård Explains Why Starring in Hideo Kojima’s Physint Is a ‘Big Deal’ for Him
cn_title: 比尔·斯卡斯加德解释主演小岛秀夫《Physint》为何对他而言「意义重大」
opus_summary: 比尔·斯卡斯加德表示，主演小岛秀夫的《Physint》对他意义重大，因为他是《潜龙谍影》系列的忠实粉丝。他确认将为游戏进行表演捕捉，并分享了与小岛秀夫关于电影的对话。《Physint》近期由索尼转交XBOX，微软接手后项目得以继续。

paragraphs.en: In September 2026, Hollywood’s resident horror icon Bill Skarsgård was confirmed to play the lead role in Hideo Kojima’s highly anticipated action-espionage project Physint .
paragraphs.cn: 2026年9月，确认好莱坞恐怖片常客比尔·斯卡斯加德将在小岛秀夫备受期待的动作谍报项目《Physint》中担任主角。

paragraphs.en: This game marks a long-awaited return to form from Kojima as fans pine for another Metal Gear-style experience. And while much about it is still unknown, we got just a smidge more information about the project thanks to its leading man, Bill Skarsgård.
paragraphs.cn: 这款游戏标志着小岛秀夫期待已久的回归，粉丝们一直渴望再次获得《潜龙谍影》式的体验。尽管有关游戏的许多内容仍不得而知，但多亏了主演比尔·斯卡斯加德，我们又得知了一点关于这个项目的信息。

paragraphs.en: Skarsgård opened up about the game in a November 5 episode of Josh Horowitz’s Happy Sad Confused podcast, where he revealed that he’s a massive fan of the Metal Gear series and shared a conversation he had with Kojima regarding his love for cinema.
paragraphs.cn: 斯卡斯加德在11月5日播出的Josh Horowitz播客《Happy Sad Confused》的一期节目中畅谈了这款游戏。他透露自己是《潜龙谍影》系列的超级粉丝，还分享了他与小岛秀夫关于小岛对电影的热爱的对话。

paragraphs.en: “That’s a big deal for me,” he said. “Specifically, the Metal Gear Solid games. I played every single [one], at least the ones on [console] platform. Starting from the one on PlayStation 1 all the way to the last one. I was very enamored by [Kojima], the mythology and the universes he creates, but also the sort of mystique and allure about him, as well.
paragraphs.cn: 「这对我来说意义重大，」他说，「尤其是《潜龙谍影》系列游戏。我每一部都玩过，至少［主机］平台上的都玩过。从PlayStation 1上的那一部一直玩到最后一部。我非常着迷于［小岛秀夫］、他创造的神话和宇宙，也着迷于他身上那种神秘感和魅力。

paragraphs.en: “I was really into it growing up. He is an auteur, but he’s a video game auteur. He’s fluent in filmmaking, and film, and cinema. I think at this point, I remember at one point way back, 20 years ago, there was talk of a Metal Gear solid movie. ‘Is Hideo going to direct it? Of course, I can’t wait to see him transition into film.’ I asked him, ‘Would you ever do a film?’ and he’s like, ‘No.’ At this point, what he’s doing is inventing a new medium. It is film. It’s eight hours worth of narrative, but it’s also an entire universe that you play. It truly is, quite literally, worldbuilding. Now, with technology, we’re getting closer and closer to something that's photorealistic and interactive when you play it. He’s a pioneer, and he keeps going out to untreaded waters.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我从小就很着迷于此。他是一位作者，但他是一位电子游戏作者。他精通电影制作、影片和电影艺术。我想说，我记得很久以前，大约20年前，曾有人谈论过《潜龙谍影》电影。『秀夫会执导吗？当然，我迫不及待想看到他转向电影。』我问过他：『你会拍电影吗？』他说：『不会。』现阶段，他正在做的是发明一种新媒介。那就是电影。它有长达八小时的叙事，但它同时也是一个供你游玩的完整宇宙。这真正是、从字面意义上来说，是在构建世界。如今，借助技术，我们正越来越接近一种游玩时既逼真得如同照片又具有互动性的东西。他是一位先驱，而且一直在探索无人涉足的领域。」

paragraphs.en: Skarsgård went on to confirm that he is providing performance capture for the game, something he already has experience with thanks to his role in Marvel’s Eternals and his extensive past working with mocap studio Goodbye Kansas (known for Alan Wake 2, God of War, Cyberpunk 2077 and many more).
paragraphs.cn: 斯卡斯加德接着确认，他正在为这款游戏进行表演捕捉。他此前凭借在漫威《永恒族》中的角色，以及过去与动作捕捉工作室Goodbye Kansas的大量合作，已经积累了这方面的经验。Goodbye Kansas曾参与《心灵杀手2》《战神》《赛博朋克2077》等众多作品的制作。

paragraphs.en: This is the latest glimpse into the game we’ve gotten since the cast was revealed in September, which also includes Charlee Fraser, Don Lee, and Minami Hamabe. And in early October, Kojima discussed Physint in a podcast, saying he wants the project to “evoke the roots of Metal Gear Solid games” but be a “new interactive experience with a different kind of spy action,” as told by IGN’s Ryan McCaffrey .
paragraphs.cn: 这是自9月公布演员阵容以来，我们对这款游戏获得的最新一点了解；阵容还包括查莉·弗雷泽、马东锡和滨边美波。10月初，小岛秀夫在一档播客中谈到了《Physint》。据IGN的Ryan McCaffrey转述，小岛表示，他希望这个项目「唤起《潜龙谍影》系列游戏的根源」，但同时成为一种「具有不同类型谍报动作的全新互动体验」。

paragraphs.en: Most notably, Physint recently changed hands from Sony to Xbox ; in a bombshell statement, Kojima said the game faced cancellation from the PlayStation parent company, but luckily, Microsoft stepped in to keep it alive. Sources told Bloomberg the project "missed deadlines and was on track to be well over budget despite being years away from release," suggesting that PlayStation’s seemingly sudden decision to drop the game was a direct result of these issues.
paragraphs.cn: 最值得注意的是，《Physint》最近从索尼转到了XBOX手中；小岛秀夫在一份重磅声明中表示，这款游戏曾面临被PlayStation母公司取消的命运，但幸运的是，微软出手让它得以继续开发。消息人士告诉彭博社，该项目「错过了截止期限，而且尽管距离发售还有数年时间，预算却很可能严重超支」，这表明PlayStation看似突然放弃这款游戏的决定是这些问题的直接结果。

paragraphs.en: For now, fans can look forward to the Death Stranding anime , as well as watch out for more from Kojima’s upcoming horror game, OD Knock , starring Hunter Schafer and Sophia Lillis. News on the Metal Gear movie continues to be sparse, with its last big update happening earlier this year when Final Destination: Bloodlines duo Zach Lipovsky and Adam B. Stein were brought on to direct .
paragraphs.cn: 目前，粉丝们可以期待《死亡搁浅》动画，也可以关注更多有关小岛秀夫即将推出的恐怖游戏《OD Knock》的消息，该游戏由亨特·莎弗和索菲娅·莉莉丝主演。《潜龙谍影》电影的消息仍然寥寥，最近一次重大进展发生在今年早些时候，《死神来了6：血脉诅咒》导演搭档Zach Lipovsky和Adam B. Stein受聘执导该片。
